tools.name: record_click
tools.description: Records that someone followed a link on a CourtsApp card, for CourtsApp's own click statistics. tools.name: get_coach_profile
tools.description: The coach card calls this when someone opens a coach's profile. It is not needed to find a coach, which search_lessons does. Read-only: it returns the bio, the places, the lesson lengths and the cancellation policy. It does not return a price.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_courts, get_booking_link, get_facility_details, search_open_play, get_lesson_booking_link, search_tournaments · Private data: get_facility_details, search_lessons, get_lesson_times, get_lesson_booking_link, record_click · Public sink: search_courts, get_facility_details, search_open_play, search_lessons, get_lesson_times, get_lesson_booking_link, search_tournaments · Destructive: search_open_play.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_courts, get_booking_link, get_facility_details, search_open_play, get_lesson_booking_link, search_tournaments · Private data: get_facility_details, search_lessons, get_lesson_times, get_lesson_booking_link, record_click · Public sink: search_courts, get_facility_details, search_open_play, search_lessons, get_lesson_times, get_lesson_booking_link, search_tournaments · Destructive: search_open_play

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
